purpose: Test whether the current frozen experience allocator spends a fixed proposal budget toward historically successful mechanism classes using only pre-result source descriptors, with each target's own outcome-derived evidence removed before allocation.
required_integrity: stage1 does not read or import the outcome file
every source descriptor is hash-pinned to a record created before the target's benchmark result was known
each target's own outcome-derived positive evidence is excluded from its experience build
the artifact view passed to the allocator omits historical summaries and task-specific outcome evidence
all arms consume exactly the same proposal budget
official FVD holdouts and the blocked IPWM real corpus remain unopened
stage2 may read outcomes only after the allocation artifact exists

interpretation.pass: Development evidence that the current allocator is worth advancing to broader apprenticeship replay. It is not confirmatory transfer evidence and does not unlock a breakthrough claim.
interpretation.fail: Do not select official FVD holdouts. Diagnose the allocator or experience representation in a new development revision without weakening this frozen replay result.
